Select distinct molecule identifiers, compound names, and canonical SMILES for all molecules associated with document CHEMBL1142710. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to enforce availability of canonical_smiles. Return columns chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort rows by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
